objective: Move ClinicOps discoverability toward an evidence-backed 8/10 state without using traffic or content volume as a substitute for qualified discovery.
review_point: after each material indexing/entity change or qualified discovery event
stop_condition: redesign any query/content lane that is indexed but produces no relevant visibility or buyer movement after a meaningful observation period

workers.objective: Reconcile ClinicOps-controlled public entity surfaces against the canonical current positioning.
success_criteria: one canonical company identity is explicit
stale positioning and SLA language are removed where controllable
workers.stop_condition: stop when accessible surfaces are reconciled or only a reserved/manual platform action remains
workers.notes: Public-safe synthetic mission template. Real account actions and evidence remain private.

workers.objective: Map high-intent non-branded buyer/search language to existing canonical ClinicOps landing pages.
success_criteria: at least five query families are evidence-backed
each query family maps to one canonical page
each page has a proof/conversion path
no thin SEO page factory is created
workers.stop_condition: stop when the selected query families have canonical landing coverage or evidence rejects the query

workers.objective: Verify and improve discovery/indexing of the priority ClinicOps URL set using available controlled channels.
success_criteria: priority URL indexing states are recorded
technical blockers are separated from crawler/index lag
external verification follows every material action
workers.stop_condition: stop when remaining actions require unavailable account permissions or repeated submissions add no new information
